rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something typical or ordinary.

example.english: My usual breakfast on weekdays is usually bread and coffee.
example.traditional: 我平日嘅早餐一般都係麵包同咖啡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 jat6 ge3 zou2 caan1 jat1 bun1 dou1 hai6 min6 baau1 tung4 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something commonly occurs or is frequently seen.

example.english: This kind of skin problem is usual in summer.
example.traditional: 呢種皮膚問題喺夏天好常見。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 pei4 fu1 man6 tai4 hai2 haa6 tin1 hou2 soeng4 gin3
